title: SV40 Large T Antigen Disrupts Embryogenesis of Canine and Porcine SCNT Embryo
author: Eun, Hwang, et al.
materials: Whole cell extracts were prepared using RIPA lysis buffer (150 mM NaCl, 1% NP-40, 0.1% SDS, and 50 mM Tris [pH 7.4]) containing 1 mM β-glycerophosphate, 2.5 mM sodium pyrophosphate, 1 mM NaF, 1 mM Na3VO4, and protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, Basel, Switzerland). Protein levels were quantified using Bradford assay reagent (Bio-Rad, Hercules, CA, USA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE and transferred to polyvinylidene difluoride membranes (Pal Corporation, Bronx, NY, USA) according to standard protocols. Membranes were immunoblotted with antibodies against c-H-RAS (Calbiochem, Darmstadt, Germany) and SV40LT antigen (Santa Cruz Biotechnology, Inc., Santa Cruz, CA, USA) in 3% bovine serum albumin Tris-buffered saline containing Tween-20 buffer. After primary antibody incubation, membranes were probed with horseradish peroxidase-conjugated goat anti-mouse IgG (Pierce Biotechnology, Inc., Rockford, IL, USA) or horseradish peroxidase-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG (Pierce Biotechnology, Inc.) secondary antibody. β-Actin was used as a loading control.

steps.title: Wash and sterilize ear tissues
steps.instruction: Rinse ear tissues from stillborn pigs and dogs in Dulbecco’s phosphate‑buffered saline‑plus (PBS+) containing 1 % (v/v) antibiotic‑antimycotic, then sterilize by immersion in 70 % ethanol and rinse again with PBS+.

steps.title: Mince skin and digest with trypsin
steps.instruction: Separate skin from the sterilized ear tissue, finely chop with a blade, and incubate the minced skin in 0.25 % trypsin for 2 h.

steps.title: Neutralize trypsin and plate cells
steps.instruction: Add Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s medium (DMEM) containing 10 % (v/v) fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 2 % (v/v) antibiotic‑antimycotic to neutralize the trypsin, then transfer the suspension to a 100‑mm culture dish.

steps.title: Incubate primary fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Place the dish in a humidified incubator set to 37 °C with 5 % CO₂; allow adherent cells to grow and subculture as needed.

steps.title: Maintain fibroblast growth medium
steps.instruction: Culture dog and pig fetal fibroblasts in DMEM supplemented with 10 % FBS, 1 % Glutamax, 1 % non‑essential amino acids, 1 % antibiotic‑antimycotic, and 0.1 % 2‑mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and lyse them in RIPA buffer (150 mM NaCl, 1 % NP‑40, 0.1 % SDS, 50 mM Tris pH 7.4) supplemented with 1 mM β‑glycerophosphate, 2.5 mM sodium pyrophosphate, 1 mM NaF, 1 mM Na₃VO₄, and a protease‑inhibitor cocktail (Roche).

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure protein levels of the lysates using Bradford assay reagent (Bio‑Rad) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE and transfer
steps.instruction: Separate equal amounts of protein by SDS‑PAGE, then transfer the resolved proteins onto polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF) membranes (Pal Corporation).

steps.title: Block and primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Block membranes in 3 % bovine serum albumin (BSA) Tris‑buffered saline containing Tween‑20 (TBS‑T), then incubate with primary antibodies against c‑H‑RAS (Calbiochem) and SV40LT antigen (Santa Cruz Biotechnology) diluted in the same blocking buffer.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: After washing, incubate membranes with horseradish peroxidase‑conjugated goat anti‑mouse IgG or goat anti‑rabbit IgG (Pierce Biotechnology) as appropriate; use β‑actin antibody as a loading control.

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Repeat each experiment at least three times, analyze the data with one‑way ANOVA followed by Duncan’s test using SPSS software, and consider differences significant when p < 0.05.
